body.prompt: Photorealistic industrial design photograph of a daily-carry aerial camera quadcopter. Orthographic 90-degree overhead, nose at twelve o'clock. True X, four motors, arms at 45 degrees to the nose axis, square hub layout, opposite hubs 250 mm apart. Four stationary propellers, each a single balanced pair of opposite equal blades, 125 mm tip to tip. Slender spindle body, 2.6:1. Twin longitudinal ridges cradle a slim flush camera hood at the nose; its tapered U-shaped rim is visible from above. Long blade-like arm roots run alongside the body then sweep diagonally outward in one uninterrupted taper. Satin warm-grey molded shell, graphite composite arms, charcoal blades. Soft 5500 K sidelight, defined contact shadows, pale seamless background. Use the four reference endpoints for motor locations. Unlettered product, full aircraft in frame.
